rca of the issue: 1) Route ordering bug (FIXED): FastAPI registers routes in declaration order. The generic catalog route `@router.patch('/{ctype}/{cid}')` was declared BEFORE the specific `@router.patch('/custom-fields/{fid}')`, so any PATCH/DELETE on /api/catalogs/custom-fields/123 matched the generic route with ctype='custom-fields'. The generic handler ran update_one({type:'custom-fields', id:123}) which never matched → 404. Fix: moved custom-fields routes above generic routes and added ctype-in-CATALOG_TYPES check to generic PATCH/DELETE so unknown types return 400 not 404. 2) Reports trends/heatmap 500s (NOT FIXED): pre-existing — reports.py line 214 references r['_id']['u'] but the aggregation produced a different _id shape. Iteration 2 said this was passing; something changed in the pipeline between iter 2 and now. Main agent should bisect reports.py changes since iter 2.
